name: Harry's Smokehouse BBQ
facts: Harry's Oklahoma Style Smokehouse BBQ, 25501 Narbonne Ave, Lomita, CA. Open daily 11 AM-8 PM. Phone (310) 326-9842.
Dine-in arcade, 80s music weekends, free waffle fries when you dine in, catering.
This is a sample demo app; prizes and rewards are samples Harry's would set.
suggested: What prizes can I win in the game?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Harry's is open daily, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: 25501 Narbonne Ave, Lomita, CA. Tap Directions in the Visit section.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: Call Harry's at (310) 326-9842.

qa.q: Can I order online?
qa.a: Yes. Order at homeofharrysbbq.com or call (310) 326-9842. Dine-in, pick up, delivery and catering.

qa.q: Do you cater?
qa.a: Yes, Harry's caters. Call (310) 326-9842 and ask about the feasts.

qa.q: Are the waffle fries free?
qa.a: Dine in and the waffle fries are on the house.

qa.q: Do you have an arcade?
qa.a: Yes, Harry's has a dine-in arcade, plus 80s music on weekends.

qa.q: What is BBQ bologna?
qa.a: Harry's BBQ bologna is the only one in SoCal. Ask your server about it.

qa.q: Who owns Harry's?
qa.a: Pitmaster Jon Harry Bayouth, from Tulsa, Oklahoma, runs Harry's with his wife Margot Dean.

qa.q: How is the meat smoked?
qa.a: Slow and low: Harry's homemade dry rub, hickory smoked 6 to 14 hours on a Southern Pride smoker, finished with Harry's Original sauce.

qa.q: What is Oklahoma style BBQ?
qa.a: Harry learned from Oklahoma's smokehouse masters in Tulsa: hand-rubbed meats, hickory smoke, slow and low, and Harry's Original sauce.

qa.q: How do I play Route 66?
qa.a: On the road, swipe or tap a side to change lanes and grab hickory, rub, sauce and meat. At each stop, hold the screen to feed the fire and keep the needle at 225 to 250 degrees, then tap to pull the meat on the gold.

qa.q: How do I cook in the game?
qa.a: Hold your finger on the screen (or Space) to add hickory and raise the heat. Let go to cool. Keep the needle in the green; the gold middle is perfect. When the smoke bar fills, tap when the marker is on the gold.

qa.q: What do hickory logs do in the game?
qa.a: Logs are fuel. Without logs the fire heats up slowly. Rub adds +25 and sauce adds +20 to your next plate.

qa.q: What prizes can I win in the game?
qa.a: Sample prizes: 5,000 Free Cornbread w/ Honey Butter, 7,500 Free side of Mac & Cheese, 9,500 Free Aunt Cheryl's Peach Cobbler, 10,800 Free Brisket Sandwich. Kid mode: 8,000 Free Margot Dean's Homemade Cookie, 10,900 Free Cornbread. Harry's sets the real ones.

qa.q: What is Kid mode?
qa.a: Kid mode is for players 12 and under. A parent or guardian signs in with their own account first. The road is slower, the green zone is wider and kid prizes go to the parent's account.

qa.q: Is there a weekly champion?
qa.a: Yes. The top Adult score each week wins a sample prize: a Free Brisket Sandwich + Aunt Cheryl's Peach Cobbler. The board resets every Monday.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: Join Harry's Rewards: 10 points per $1, 50 for a daily QR check-in, 100 for your first order, 200 on your birthday, 250 for in-app feedback, 150 when a friend joins with your code.

qa.q: What rewards can I get?
qa.a: 500 Free Margot Dean's Homemade Cookie, 1,000 Free Cornbread, 1,800 Free side, 2,800 Free Aunt Cheryl's Peach Cobbler, 4,000 Free Brisket Sandwich.

qa.q: Is there a daily spin?
qa.a: Yes, one free spin per member per day. Odds are listed on the rules page.

qa.q: How long are prizes good for?
qa.a: Game and spin prizes are good for 3 days, one reward per visit.

qa.q: Do I have to buy anything to play?
qa.a: No. The game and the daily spin are free. No purchase is needed to win.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Your info is only used for your Harry's Rewards account and is never sold.

qa.q: Do you have desserts?
qa.a: Aunt Cheryl's Peach Cobbler $9.99, Homemade Bread Pudding $9.99 and Margot Dean's Homemade Cookie $3.49.

qa.q: What sides do you have?
qa.a: Mac & Cheese, Mashed Potatoes, Molasses Baked Beans, Waffle Fries, Fried Okra ($8.99 each), Oklahoma Red Dirt Potato Wedges $8.75, Sassy Slaw $7.99, Cornbread w/ Honey Butter $5.99.

qa.q: Is there an app?
qa.a: This is Harry's app. Tap Add to Home Screen in the game menu to keep it on your phone.
